# Charter: docs/ARCHITECTURE_V3_DRAFT_0.5.md Phase A task A6 / C13 / R15 /
# §7.12 cumulative chunk_id rewrite map.
# Per the 2026-05-27 Phase A scope-negotiation decision
# (docs/PHASE_A_SCOPE_NEGOTIATION.md)
# UIR-shim. The shim preserves the v2.16 chunker output unchanged and
# projects existing v2.X chunks to v3.0 UIRChunks at the export boundary
# via v2x_to_v3_mapper (proven lossless: A0 verdict PASS at identity
# ratio 1.0000 on ATZ_Elektronik_German; A2-shim verdict PASS at
# identity ratio 1.0000 on Earthship_Vol1.phase3_baseline + Fluent_Python
# + HarryPotter — 3
# Consequence: NO chunk_ids change between v2.16 and v3.0.0. The
# rewrite-map mechanism per C13/R15 is honored by publishing this file
# (a row count of zero is a valid map) and downstream consumers can
# confirm via this file that no migration work is required against v3.0.0.
# The full chunker / mapper / serializer rewrite (Charter Phase A task A2
# in its non-shim form) is rebooked to v3.0.2 under a future dedicated
# cycle plan. The v3.0.2 rewrite-map will live at
# docs/CHUNK_ID_REWRITE_MAP_3.0.2.csv and per §7.12 will be cumulative
# (v3.0.0 -> v3.0.2 transitively composed with this empty map = the
# v3.0.2 rewrite only).
